oss.classification: GAP / not-applicable (ternary Allen-Cahn phase field, no pseudo-potential)

decision: Decide whether CudaPhaseField may serve as a cross-validation reference for TensorLBM's MCMP (Shan-Chen) pseudo-potential Poiseuille line, or whether the transplant must be the ternary conservative Allen-Cahn phase field with a measured tension convention.
alternatives: D1 use the OSS ternary AC phase field as a phase-field reference (transplant, measured against analytic interface/tension references)
D2 use the OSS code as a pseudo-potential reference (claim: category error, no interaction strength G / no coexistence loop)
hypothesis: H1: the OSS model is a ternary conservative Allen-Cahn phase field whose coefficients satisfy sigma = lambda/2, so a literal sigma(3,3)=0.1 transplant halves the tension. H2: the phase equation is independent of the (1000,500,100) mass-density triple, hence that triple is not a thermodynamic density ratio and cannot stand in for a pseudo-potential coexistence curve.

metrics.K1_semantics: absolute error of lambda_k, harmonic coupling, w_c and the 10-90 interface width against the source-documented/analytic value
metrics.K2_profile: 10-90 interface width from three initial widths vs the same estimator applied to the analytic sampled profile
metrics.K3_mass: relative phase-mass drift over the run (machine precision expected)
metrics.K4_tension: sigma measured from the gradient energy vs lambda/2 and vs the shipped sigma-matrix value
metrics.K5_density: max |phi_a - phi_b| between density arms (bit identity expected)
metrics.K6_pseudopotential: Shan-Chen Maxwell coexistence density ratio as a function of G only

unit_of_analysis: one arm per (initial width, w, m, density triple); KPI per arm

baseline_control.estimator_control: the same node-linear width estimator is applied to the analytic sampled profile so discretisation bias cancels
baseline_control.source_control: constants re-derived from the vendored Fortran, not from the inventory text

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: owner 15% band for any physical comparison; 1e-15/1e-12 are identity/closure checks

stopping_rule: fixed arm list (3 initial widths x w=4, 3 w values, 2 m values, 2 density triples, 4 G values) run to completion; no arm added or dropped after seeing KPIs; wall clock ~110 s CPU
variables_changed: G for the Shan-Chen coexistence curve
variables_held_fixed: lambda from the shipped sigma matrix
source normalisation = literal OSS (2 a_k, /3 weighting)
confounders: node-linear crossing estimator reads +3.2% high on a sampled tanh (controlled by the analytic-sampled reference)
no fluid step: the OSS g-LBE/Korteweg coupling is out of scope, so no hydrodynamics claim is made
analysis: error vs analytic per arm, no trimming; sensitivity = w sweep + m sweep; falsification = density-arm field difference > 0 or tension matching the shipped sigma matrix
fail_stage_plan: fail_stage in {semantics, interface, tension, sensitivity, density, pseudopotential}
